label: Oman: competitions and student programmes
focus:
Find upcoming competitions in Oman that a university student can enter: hackathons, coding contests, CTFs, AI challenges, pitch and startup competitions, olympiads, innovation awards and student programmes with application deadlines.

Who runs them: universities and colleges (SQU, GUtech, UTAS and its campuses, Middle East College, MCBS, Majan, Dhofar University, University of Nizwa, Sohar University and others, plus IEEE and ACM student branches); government (MTCIT, Oman National CERT, Ministry of Higher Education, Research and Innovation, ARI, Youth Center, Riyada, Makeen); companies (Omantel, Ooredoo, Vodafone Oman, banks such as NBO and Bank Muscat, PDO, OQ, Oman Data Park, NTG, Huawei, Cisco, Microsoft, Google, AWS, Oracle).

Also check recurring contests whose next edition may be announced: Oman Collegiate Programming Contest, Oman National Cybersecurity CTF, Hadatha hackathons, Engineer It with AI, UpGrade, Student Startup Programme, Techstars Startup Weekend, Hacktivate CTF, Huawei ICT Competition Oman round, PDO hackathons, COMEX hackathon.

label: Oman: events, expos and career fairs
focus:
Find upcoming events in Oman between now and mid-2027: technology, AI, cybersecurity, fintech and startup conferences, expos, summits, forums, workshops, meetups, career fairs and entrepreneurship weeks, in person or online.

Check the OCEC and Knowledge Oasis Muscat calendars, COMEX, Oman Sustainability Week, Global Entrepreneurship Week Oman, Riyada, Injaz Oman, Sharakah, university career days, and communities such as GDG Muscat and AWS user groups on Meetup, Luma and Eventbrite. For each event note the price and whether students get a free or reduced entry.

label: Oman: funding, accelerators and training programmes
focus:
Find programmes with applications or calls in Oman: accelerators and incubators, grants, scholarships, training and bootcamps, graduate programmes, regulation and tenders that affect a small software business.

Check Oman Technology Fund (Techween, Wadi), Numo, Omantel Innovation Labs, Future Fund Oman, Oman Development Bank, Madayn and the National Business Centre, the Industrial Innovation Academy, MTCIT digital-skills programmes, Oracle and Microsoft skills initiatives, ITHCA, banks' startup hubs, TRA and ITA. For every item say plainly who may apply: students, startups, companies or graduates.

label: GCC: competitions and programmes open to Omani students
focus:
Find hackathons, contests, CTFs, challenges and student programmes in the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Bahrain and Kuwait that accept participants from other Arab countries or online. Examples: Dubai Future Foundation, Dubai AI Week, MBZUAI, Khalifa University, NYUAD, Hub71, GITEX side competitions, SDAIA, the Hajj Hackathon, Tuwaiq Academy, KAUST, Qatar's QCRI and HBKU, Web Summit Qatar, Bahrain's Tamkeen.

Check each one's rules for non-nationals and for undergraduates, and say so in the eligibility note. Online rounds and low-cost trips inside the GCC rank highest.
